meta.name: nft-standards
meta.description: Implement NFT standards (ERC-721, ERC-1155) with proper metadata handling, minting strategies, and marketplace integration. Use when creating NFT contracts, building NFT marketplaces, or implementing digital asset systems.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发区块链上的 NFT 项目。
copy.tagline_en: Launch NFT digital assets and integrate with marketplaces.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building NFT projects on blockchain.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能写出 ERC-721 与 ERC-1155 的 Solidity 合约代码,涵盖铸造数量与价格限制、IPFS 或链上元数据、EIP-2981 版税、市场集成等模板,更多示例放在 references/details.md。
howto.when: 当你创建 NFT 合约、搭建 NFT 市场,或实现数字资产系统时触发,包括藏品、灵魂绑定代币、动态 NFT 等场景。

say.note: 会补上 royaltyInfo 与接口声明

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes Solidity contracts for ERC-721 and ERC-1155 NFTs, covering minting limits and price, IPFS or on-chain metadata, royalties (EIP-2981), and marketplace patterns. See references/details.md for more.
howto.when_en: Use when creating NFT contracts, building NFT marketplaces, or implementing digital asset systems, including collections, soulbound tokens, and dynamic NFTs.

say_en.text: Write an ERC-721 contract with 10,000 supply at 0.08 ETH and IPFS metadata.
say_en.note: Produces a contract with supply and price checks

say_en.text: Add EIP-2981 royalties at 5% to this NFT contract.
Build an ERC-1155 game items contract with batch minting.
say_en.note: Shows multi-token and batch mint functions
